groups.note: Municipal, school, and special-district names are keyed from official Sweetwater November general results in this archive. Green River, Rock Springs, Granger, Wamsutter, and (in 2026) Superior mayors appear on the official November ballot and are not council-selected. Current Town of Bairoil holders are taken from the official Town of Bairoil city-government page, retrieved 2026-11-24; Bairoil does not appear on those official November canvasses. Official 2016 general and official 2012 general are scanned precinct canvasses; 2016 county-commissioner Vote-For-2 winners and many 2012/2016 local offices were not filled from those scans and are Not yet collected rather than invented. The official county staff directory retrieved 2026-11-24 lists the Sheriff office as Vacant (Rich Fischer is listed as a Lieutenant, not as Sheriff). Official Clerk of District Court pages name Amanda L. Chetterbock as the current clerk, but no official appointment date was found, so January snapshots keep official 2022 winner Donnalee Bobak through January 2027.

groups.note: Supreme Court justices and the Chancery Court judge are the people in office this January, from official Wyoming Judicial Branch dates and official retention results (shared with other counties). Local rows are 3rd Judicial District judges. Where an official Sweetwater clerk summary prints only a last name, or omits the name (official 2022 JUDGE A DISTRICT COURT; official 2026 FOR JUDGE C OF THE DISTRICT COURT; official 2014 JUDGE JONES / JUDGE ZEBRE), the full name is taken from an official Wyoming Judicial Branch 3rd JD page or from a later official clerk ballot, and that source is cited. Sweetwater is in the 3rd Judicial District; judges of other districts are not copied here.
